# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.10

Cross-course progress queries and legacy report saves work again. The report editor keeps IDs paired during lesson changes, copies all selected lesson progress entries with the primary lesson first, and shows one student history card per report with authorized progress and notes. Quick Edit and Homework Check show pointer and focus styles.

The extension source keeps the native Remaining Lessons pagination and preserves the source filters. Extension distribution uses its separate release process.

Apply pending migrations through `1000179_student_report_reference_history.sql`, then deploy the frontend, API, and Presidio images tagged `2.0.0-alpha.10`. Bypass edge caching for SPA HTML and `/sw.js`, and purge previously cached copies when rolling out. See the [deployment guide](../../docs/deployment/environment.md).
